_comment: Synthetic subject-pack manifest for tools/test_calibration_kit.py (the format is tools/calibration/subject-pack/README.md). No real repository: the commits are placeholders and grade.sh is never run on this file.

subject.name: a two-function arithmetic module
subject.promise: add returns the sum of its arguments and never raises on two numbers
subject.reference: src/mod.py (its docstring states the promise) and tests/test_mod.py (the harness)

findings.summary: add raises on a negative argument instead of answering the sum
findings.cause: the bound check in add rejects a < 0
findings.required_behaviour: add answers the sum for any two numbers and never raises
findings.found_rule: a finding says a negative argument makes add raise
findings.cause_rule: it locates the cause in the bound check of add

findings.found_rule: a finding says add answers the difference
findings.cause_rule: it locates the cause in the return expression of add

pin.pass_rule: the candidate's new tests fail at the base tree AND pass with the accepted source AND no file under the source directory changes AND lint is clean
pin.instructions: Write it as a two-row test (two pairs of numbers).

fix.pass_rule: the candidate's tests are green at its head AND red with the source restored to the base AND the accepted test is green against the candidate's source AND every changed file is in scope AND lint is clean

review.pass_rule: PASS when every ground-truth finding is found AND adjudicated falseBlocking is 0 AND copiedFromHistory is false; PARTIAL when some but not all are found under the same two conditions; FAIL otherwise

isolation: candidate checkouts are history-less trees of the case base only; the accepted fix, the ground truth and this manifest stay outside every candidate's permitted paths
commit_rule: the repository's commit hook refuses a commit that changes a file under src/ unless docs/MAP.md is staged in the same commit
